note: Deletes the duplicate managed-reverse-proxy doc page outright; removes the duplication but does not move the root-redirect section into or link to the existing article.
Keeps _dependency_ids and adds a comment explaining why it differs from flag_dependency_properties (skips malformed groups), the offered alternative.
Splits resolveDateRange into parsedDateTo and inclusiveDateTo steps with comments stating date_to is exclusive and the millisecond step.
Only rewrites doc comments in serialization/mod.rs and kafka.rs about data_type-based encoding; the seam still returns the sink error type, no local error added.
Replaces manual regional client capture/shutdown with a ph_scoped_capture context manager and calls capture inside it.
Removes task_run association guidance from MCP tools and prompts, makes claims auto-record the task association, task-run artefacts read-only, ownership derived from claims.
Adds website_domain to account properties, populates it on the model, drops the custom-property queries, resolves logo from website_domain falling back to email domains.
Changes RequestFailure event_count to count the pending batch; the lane field name is untouched.
Moves the inline CLI install and release-resolve script into a composite action with its own CLI version pin, used by both workflows.

Extracts ScoutWriteAccessTag component and renders it in both ScoutNameCell and ScoutRosterCard.
Deletes the facade wrapper pi_cloud_runtime_enabled and imports a single pi_cloud_runtime_enabled gate from feature_flags.
Renames resolve_object_access and resolve_resource_access to resolve_most_specific_object_access and resolve_most_specific_resource_access, plus callers and tests.
Scheduled-change error message now formats the rollout sum via format_variant_rollout_sum, with the import added.
experimentLogic variant key validation now calls shared validateFeatureFlagVariantKey instead of the inline regex.
Duplicate-key lookup moved to failure listener and uses generated featureFlagsList with typed key param, picking exact key match.
Adds MATERIALIZED_VIEW_SYNC_FAILED_DAILY and _IMMEDIATE to NotificationSetting enum and Literal, handled in should_send_notification and a helper.
Moves reportFeatureFlagsBulkArchived to an eventUsageLogic action connected into flagSelectionLogic, removing the plain function.
Moves gRPC stream id and seq into a feed-time batch context type; the stream ingest driver stays an inline object in the server, no class extracted.
Extracts restriction_fingerprint into the access-control property_access facade and uses it here and in the other sort-key call sites.
